description.narrative: This grant is to build capacity and systems for “The Climate Network" (TCN), using NCN’s model as a ‘blueprint’ to be replicated in other countries. Proposed countries for expansion are Tanzania, South Africa and Uganda. TCN will build local communities of professionals driving climate action in these new countries. It will enable individuals and organisations to connect, to collaborate with peers and prospective partners and to contribute to building a more enabling environment for climate action. This ecosystem of actors can work both locally and across chapters to share learnings and build momentum for climate solutions. The ultimate goal is to help these member organisations to solve the climate crisis faster and more effectively through their work.

activity-date.narrative: Planned phase one completion covered by this grant

recipient-country.narrative: The majority of the funds are spent in Kenya - but the capacity building for expansion will benefit multiple countries both immediately and over the longer term as this funding enables us to build systems to expand impact.
This grant has supported the launch event and expansion of the network to South Africa as part of Earthshot week in November 2024.
